dish.title: Japanese Vegetable Curry Rice with a Homemade Roux
dish.description: A mild, glossy Japanese-style curry made from scratch: onions cooked until sweet, then potatoes, carrots, and mushrooms simmered and thickened with a toasted flour-and-oil curry roux, with grated apple and a dash of soy and ketchup for depth. Served over short-grain rice.

recipe_version.title: Japanese Vegetable Curry Rice with a Homemade Roux
recipe_version.description: A mild, glossy Japanese-style curry made from scratch: onions cooked until sweet, then potatoes, carrots, and mushrooms simmered and thickened with a toasted flour-and-oil curry roux, with grated apple and a dash of soy and ketchup for depth. Served over short-grain rice.

ingredients.name: ketchup
ingredients.display_name: ketchup whose label lists no honey

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice until the rinse runs nearly clear. Slice the onions, cut the potatoes and carrots, halve the mushrooms, grate the apple, and slice the scallions.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 1/2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Cook the onions
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium. Cook the onions, stirring now and then, until soft and lightly golden, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.body: Add the potatoes, carrots, mushrooms, apple, 4 cups water, and 1 1/2 tsp salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered until the potatoes and carrots are tender, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.body: While the vegetables simmer, heat 4 tbsp oil in an 8-inch skillet over medium-low, whisk in the flour, and cook, whisking, until the color of peanut butter, about 8 minutes. Whisk in the curry powder and garam masala for 30 seconds and take off the heat (overlap stated).

steps.title: Thicken the curry
steps.body: Ladle about 1 cup of the simmering liquid into the roux and whisk smooth, then stir it back into the pot with the soy sauce and ketchup. Simmer, stirring, until glossy and thick, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice, pack it to one side of each plate, ladle the curry alongside, and top with scallions.

recipe_version.heat: Medium in a 5-quart Dutch oven for the onions, a gentle simmer for the vegetables. Medium-low in a small skillet for the roux. Low covered heat for the rice.
